effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the errata'd text (DUSA-EN046, Duelist Saga) Independently corroborated by Konami's own errata announcement and the archived Forbidden & Limited List page carrying its effective date; the printing remains the anchor because it is when the text first became available in the TCG (the announcement and the F/L effective date differ by a few days).

corroboration.title: Konami, CURRENT CARD ERRATA LIST, compiled July 30 2009
corroboration.quote: An 'errata' is a correction to the text on a card. If a card has errata, you should always play the card as if it had the corrected text, even though your actual card might have older text.

changes.historical_text: Pay 800 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.
changes.modern_text: Pay 800 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that can be Normal Summoned/Set; take control of that target until the End Phase.
changes.summary: Functional erratum: the target clause gains 'that can be Normal Summoned/Set', so the modern card can no longer take control of Extra Deck monsters or of monsters that cannot be Normal Summoned. The pre-errata script's filter is 'c:IsControlerCanBeChanged() and c:IsFaceup()' with no c:IsSummonableCard() test, so any face-up monster the opponent controls is a legal target - a Synchro Monster included, which is exactly what makes the difference load-bearing for the 2010 snapshot.

review.notes: No goat variant; the baseline is the pre-errata variant, whose cdb text matches lineage v5 (YGLD-ENA26, 2015-11-12) exactly, so the chain starts there. Versions v0 (TLM-EN038, 2005-06-01) through v4 are cosmetic rewordings of the same effect ('Select 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field' -> 'target ... your opponent controls', 'Life Points' -> 'LP') and carry no behavioural difference, so GOAT and Edison are both correctly served by this baseline. The packet's other upstream entry, 511002549 'Brain Control (Anime)', is a different card, not an artwork variant: its script has no LP cost at all (no Cost.PayLP(800)) and its text is the anime wording. The pre-errata script's inline s.cost is equivalent to the modern Cost.PayLP(800). None of the other eleven cards in this batch appear on EdisonFormat.com's Functional Errata page, which is an Edison-scope list, so their absence there is not evidence either way.
